description: Route each support ticket to billing, technical, or sales based on its primary request. Billing handles existing charges, invoices, and refunds. Technical handles product failures and troubleshooting. Sales handles prospective purchases, pricing, and product demonstrations. This small authored dataset illustrates the workflow; it is not a benchmark.
